categories.main_business_segments: Suruga Bank operates primarily in the banking sector, focusing on retail and community banking, with additional financial services provided through its consolidated subsidiaries. The group’s main business segments include deposit-taking, lending, domestic exchange, securities and investment trust sales, and insurance agency services. Subsidiaries also offer consumer finance, leasing, credit card, guarantee, printing, and IT system development services. The core segment is banking, with other financial and support services supplementing the main business.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The bank leverages advanced IT platforms, online banking systems, and digital channels to deliver financial services, including web and smartphone-based non-face-to-face transactions. It employs robust risk management, compliance, and internal control systems, as well as proprietary portfolio management and credit assessment methodologies. The group also utilizes in-house developed systems for business process automation and customer relationship management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Suruga Bank primarily serves individual retail customers, small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), and real estate investors, with a strong focus on personal loans, mortgage loans, and investment property loans. The bank also targets local communities in Shizuoka and Kanagawa prefectures, as well as customers in the Tokyo metropolitan area. Its end markets include retail banking, real estate finance, and consumer finance.
categories.geographic_coverage: The bank’s operations are concentrated in Japan, with a strong presence in Shizuoka and Kanagawa prefectures, and additional branches in Tokyo, Osaka, Sapporo, Nagoya, Fukuoka, and other major cities. All revenue is derived from domestic operations, and the bank does not maintain overseas branches or significant international business activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Suruga Bank operates at the downstream end of the financial services supply chain, directly interfacing with end customers as a retail and community bank. It provides financial products and services directly to consumers and businesses, acting as a financial intermediary and service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The bank’s strategic focus is on evolving its retail and community banking business, building a sustainable earnings structure, and enhancing risk management and diversification. Key initiatives include digital transformation (DX), IT platform investment, strengthening asset consulting, and expanding collaboration with partners such as Credit Saison. Human capital development, diversity, and sustainability (including carbon neutrality by 2030) are also emphasized. There is no significant traditional R&D, but ongoing investment in digital, compliance, and risk management capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through interest income from loans, fees from deposit and settlement services, commissions from investment trust and insurance sales, and other financial services. Additional income streams include leasing, credit card fees, and guarantee fees from subsidiaries. The business model is based on traditional banking intermediation and fee-based services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Suruga Bank is positioned as a regional bank with a unique focus on retail and investment property lending, differentiating itself from larger city banks and other regional banks. Major competitors include other regional banks in Shizuoka, Kanagawa, and the Tokyo area, as well as national banks and non-bank financial institutions. The bank has a strategic partnership with Credit Saison, enhancing its competitive position in retail finance and card services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, Suruga Bank reported consolidated ordinary income of approximately 91.1 billion yen and net income attributable to parent shareholders of 20.2 billion yen. Total consolidated assets were 3.46 trillion yen, with a consolidated capital adequacy ratio of 11.84%. The bank has demonstrated a recovery and growth trajectory in recent years, exceeding its mid-term management plan targets for profit and capital adequacy.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Suruga Bank emphasizes customer-centric service, flexible and innovative retail banking solutions, and personalized asset consulting, particularly for individuals and real estate investors. Its value proposition includes digital convenience, local community engagement, and a commitment to compliance and sustainability. The bank differentiates itself through its specialized expertise in investment property lending, digital banking capabilities, and strong regional presence.
